reply:
Here is the three-tier pricing comparison. The middle tier, Pro, is marked as recommended.

<a2ui-json>
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9.1",
    "createSurface": {
      "surfaceId": "pricing",
      "catalogId": "https://a2uicatalog.ai/catalog/c-marketing-commerce.json"
    }
  },
  {
    "version": "v0.9.1",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "pricing",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "pricing_tier_group",
          "tiers": [
            {
              "name": "Starter",
              "price": "$9",
              "period": "per month",
              "description": "For individuals getting started.",
              "features": [
                "1 project",
                "5 GB storage",
                "Basic analytics",
                "Email support"
              ],
              "recommended": false,
              "cta_label": "Start free trial",
              "cta_url": "#starter"
            },
            {
              "name": "Pro",
              "price": "$29",
              "period": "per month",
              "description": "For growing teams that need more power.",
              "features": [
                "Unlimited projects",
                "100 GB storage",
                "Advanced analytics",
                "Priority support",
                "Team collaboration"
              ],
              "recommended": true,
              "badge": "Recommended",
              "cta_label": "Get Pro",
              "cta_url": "#pro"
            },
            {
              "name": "Enterprise",
              "price": "$99",
              "period": "per month",
              "description": "For organizations with advanced needs.",
              "features": [
                "Unlimited everything",
                "1 TB storage",
                "Custom reporting",
                "Dedicated account manager",
                "SSO and audit logs",
                "99.99% uptime SLA"
              ],
              "recommended": false,
              "cta_label": "Contact sales",
              "cta_url": "#enterprise"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
</a2ui-json>

The catalog doesn't define the fields inside each tier. I chose `name`, `price`, `period`, `description`, `features`, `recommended`, `badge`, `cta_label` and `cta_url`, so the renderer may ignore any it doesn't recognize.
